title: Station Contract
description: Generic capability-based contract for one ASSY station. OPS-01 design/contract only — no runtime implementation at this gate.

quality_decision.description: Operation yields a PASS/FAIL/NG quality decision.

exception.description: Operation may raise HOLD / LINE OUT / note.

identity_transformation.description: Operation transforms WIP identity (e.g. AP04 JOIN).

default_mode.description: Default completion mode for this station contract (lowest precedence fallback).

mode_override.description: Explicit per-station mode override. Highest precedence when configured; overrides the global run mode and the station default.

normal_action.description: Primary completion action exposed by the station.

required_action.description: Action required before the WIP is eligible to index.

work_duration_s.description: Configured simulated operation duration, independent of visual animation timing.

prerequisites.description: Station IDs whose contracts must be satisfied before this station may execute (e.g. AP04 requires AP03).

checklist_items.description: Neutral required checklist item ids for the gated action (empty when checklist is not a completion gate).

checklist_required_for_action.description: The action gated by checklist completion. Null when checklist capability does not gate an action.
